children: Australian shares were poised to open lower on Monday, with miners likely to take a hit from weaker copper and gold prices, while sentiment remained fragile after last week's soft jobs data stoked fears of a sharp economic slowdown.
The local share price index futures (YAPcm1) fell 0.6%, a 36.6-point discount to the underlying S&P/ASX 200 index
close. The benchmark fell 1.6% on Friday.
